fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the product packshot on Schmidt Spiele's page https://www.schmidtspiele.de/detail/product/the-quacks-of-quedlinburg.html. The article number and language variant on that page match this rule record; reduced to 325 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently cooked something is the first starting player. They hold the Fortune Teller deck and read its opening card; everyone brews potions at the same time.
houseFallback: If the cooking criterion leaves a tie, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule, not an official tie-break.
clarifications: The starting-player role passes clockwise with the Fortune Teller deck after each round.
During ordinary brewing, players do not have individual turns or have to draw chips in lockstep. In the final round, the starter calls for everyone to draw together.
